probes: 8 FRESH prompts (none from H1-H4) + Ottawa factual check
conditions: L14_plus_ctrl<n>_-1.0 and _-1.5 for 5 control neurons (10 conditions)
controls: 5 L17 neurons drawn at random (seed 5) from the 50 neurons whose down_proj column norm is closest to N9209's; selected in-kernel, ids and natural prompt-token activations recorded in results
reset: L17 N9209 clamped at every position (prompt prefill and each generated step) to the baseline run's value at the same position; beyond the baseline length, baseline generated-token mean. Limitation: once text diverges, baseline values belong to different tokens.
metrics: Per condition: distinct 4-gram ratio, share of outputs hitting the 80-token cap, mean logprob of generated tokens under the steered model and under the unsteered model. Hostility and coherence rated separately by manual reading at analysis time.
budget: 17 conditions x 9 prompts = 153 generations; H4 ran 72 in ~10.5 min, estimate ~25-35 min GPU, under 1.5h
trimmed: Dose -0.9 dropped (grid -0.75/-1.0/-1.25 plus -1.5 for control match); pair (L13) conditions dropped; residual-direction test (hyp. B) deferred; second blind rater and multiple seeds deferred; controls only at -1.0 and -1.5
